name: Ranger Forward Vanguard
body:
Ranges are known for scouting ahead and finding danger before it can find them. The forward vanguard takes it a step further and focuses their efforts on protecting their allies against the threats they do find.

Mettle (Ex)

At 1st level, a forward vanguard gains a Mettle pool that is refreshed each day. The pool’s maximum is equal to the forward vanguard’s Wisdom modifier, plus any feats and special abilities that increases the pool maximum. Some abilities may restore points to this pool during the day. But the forward vanguard may not have more points of Mettle than the pool’s maximum.

The forward vanguard may expend Mettle to gain one of the following benefits.

As an immediate action they may gain a bonus equal to their Wisdom modifier on the next non-Will saving throw. The bonus must be used before the beginning of their next turn.
As part of making a Dexterity check to gain a bonus equal to their Charisma bonus. The defender of the faith may restore a point of Mettle to your pool in the following ways.
If the defender of the faith uses the aid another action to assist an ally’s skill check and the ally would have failed the check without the vanguard’s action
If the defender of the faith uses the aid another action to improve an ally’s AC and the ally would have been hit without the their action

If an ability which expends Mettle allows for the use of an attack of opportunity, the attack of opportunity allowed by that ability may be taken even while using the total defense action.

Survival Training (Ex)

At 1st level, the forward vanguard is a master of scouting and tracking. They gain a bonus equal to 1/2 their forward vanguard levels on Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (geography), Survival and Stealth checks.

This ability replaces track and wild empathy.

Guerrilla Tactics (Ex)

The forward vanguard is an expert at hit-and-run tactics. At 2nd level, they gain Dodge and Run as bonus feats and at 3rd level, they gain Mobility as a bonus feat. They need not meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats.

At 6th level, if the forward vanguard moves 10 feet or more in a round and makes a single attack they add an additional damage die to their attack as per the Vital Strike feat. An additional die is added at 11th as per the Improved Vital Strike feat and 16th level as per the Greater Vital Strike feat. The additional die of damage are only applied if the forward vanguard is wearing light or nor armor, though may be used in conjunction with a charge. This ability is treated as the iteration of Vital Strike the level notates for prerequisite purposes.

This ability replaces the combat style feats gained at 2nd, 6th, 10th and 14th levels.

Screen Them (Ex)

At 3rd level, the forward vanguard may charge forth to defend an ally. The forward vanguard may elect to place themselves in the path of danger in order to protect an ally. When rolling initiative, they may select a target as a charge. This selection may not change for the duration of the encounter. If the charge is the target of an attack, the forward vanguard may make a move as an immediate action to get themselves within 5 feet of their charge. Then they enter the square occupied by the charge and receive the attack in their place. To do so, the forward vanguard must make an Acrobatics check with a DC equal to 1/2 the feet required to be moved up to the forward vanguard’s double move distance. However, any movement used in this ability is deducted from the forward vanguard’s movement in their next turn. The attack automatically hits the forward vanguard. The charge is placed in any empty square adjacent to them of the forward vanguard’s choice. The forward vanguard may declare the use of this ability after knowing whether their charge will be hit. This ability replace the favored terrains gained at 3rd and 13th levels.

Nimble Combatant (Ex)

A forward vanguard needs to be able to weave through their enemies. At 4th level, a forward vanguard may take 10 on Acrobatics to move through threatened squares. At 9th level, the forward vanguard can move at normal speed while using Acrobatics to move through threatened squares. At 15th level, the forward vanguard may take 20 on these Acrobatics checks.

This ability replaces hunter’s bond.

Charging Strikes (Ex)

At 5th level, as a full-round action, the forward vanguard may make a special charge attack. They may make their full attack anywhere along the line of the charge, though each attack must be against a different target. The attacks must be made in the order the forward vanguard encounters a target and in order of attack iteration, however, they need not attack every creature in the line. For example, a forward vanguard may charge past a creature, attack the next creature in the line at their full base attack bonus and the third encountered creature at their second attack bonus. This ability replaced the favored enemy gained at 5th and 15th levels and quarry gained at 15th level.

Active Maneuvers (Ex)

At 8th level, the forward vanguard is trained to use their confidence in their skills to enhance their maneuverability. The forward vanguard may spend a point of Mettle to apply their Charisma bonus (if any) to their CMD and touch AC, though their touch AC may not exceed their base AC.

At 12th level, the bonus may be applied to their Reflex saves.

At 18th level, these bonuses always apply and do not require a point of Mettle to enact.

This ability only functions if the forward vanguard is wearing light or no armor.

This ability replaces the favored terrains gained at 8th and 18th levels.
